mainEntity.name: How does Splitify calculate group balances?

acceptedAnswer.text: Splitify uses an intelligent greedy debt simplification algorithm to minimize total payments between group members into the fewest possible direct transactions.

mainEntity.name: Is my financial expense data stored on a central server?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Splitify stores 100% of your session and expense data locally inside your device browser using IndexedDB. No accounts or server logins are required.

mainEntity.name: How do temporary trip share links work?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you generate a share link, a temporary copy of your trip data is uploaded for 24 hours. Friends can import the trip directly into their browser, after which the link automatically expires and deletes itself.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Splitify without an internet connection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Splitify is built as a Progressive Web App (PWA). You can install it on iOS, Android, or Desktop and run it completely offline without internet.
